# Wa Banshaku Mine (和晩酌 嶺)

> An authentic Japanese restaurant (washoku) in Kume, Naha, Okinawa, Japan. The owner-chef trained for ten years at renowned restaurants in Kyoto's Gion district, Tokyo and Shizuoka. Dinner is a monthly-changing course of seasonal fish and seasonal vegetables (including Kyoto heirloom vegetables) with Japanese sake. Six counter seats, two semi-private rooms (up to 4 guests each) and one private room (up to 10 guests). By day the same kitchen opens as "Okinawa Soba Mine" (沖縄そば 嶺).

## About

Owner-chef Seigo Inamine spent ten years training in Japanese cuisine at renowned restaurants in Kyoto's Gion district, Tokyo and Shizuoka, then returned to his home of Okinawa to open this Japanese restaurant. The cooking is authentic Japanese cuisine built on fresh seasonal fish and seasonal vegetables such as Kyoto heirloom vegetables; Okinawan ingredients are used only in part.

## Dinner — Wa Banshaku Mine (和晩酌 嶺)

- **Hours**: 18:00-23:00 (last order 22:00)
- **Closed**: Sundays and Japanese public holidays
- **Reservations**: Online via TableCheck (24h, multilingual) or by phone
- **Courses (chef's omakase, tax included)**: 5 dishes ¥5,500 (small plates only, for guests who mainly come to drink) / 7 dishes ¥6,600 (includes a closing dish) / 9 dishes ¥7,700 (one additional dish, a closing dish and dessert)
- **Business-dinner course**: 2-hour all-you-can-drink + 7 dishes ¥9,900 (tax included)
- The course changes every month. Dish details are given on the day or when reserving.
- **Seating**: 6 counter seats; 2 semi-private rooms for up to 4 guests each; 1 private room for up to 10 guests

## Lunch — Okinawa Soba Mine (沖縄そば 嶺)

- **Hours**: 10:30-14:30
- **Closed**: Sundays, Tuesdays and Japanese public holidays
- **Payment**: Cash only, pay in advance.
- **Menu (tax included)**: Special Mine Soba Set ¥1,500 (most popular) / Special Mine Soba ¥1,300 / Mine Soba ¥1,100 / Soki Soba ¥900 / Sanmai-niku Soba ¥800 / Soft Yushi-tofu Soba ¥700 / chilled dipping noodles ¥800-¥1,500 / jushi (seasoned rice) ¥200-¥400. Extra noodles +¥200.
- **Broth**: bonito from Nagasaki and Makurazaki, dried sardines and Hokkaido kelp, built on the Japanese stock of the evening kitchen and layered with pork broth. Fresh noodles by Chinen Seimenjo (Okinawa City).
- **Page**: https://wabanshaku-mine.search-mania.net/lunch/

## Location

- **Address**: Akamine Building 1F #102, 1-7-21 Kume, Naha, Okinawa 900-0033, Japan
- **Nearest station**: Asahibashi Station (Okinawa Yui Rail), about 9 minutes on foot
- **Parking**: No private parking. Paid coin-parking lots are within walking distance.
- **Phone**: +81-98-975-5673
